name: Mosskin
ecology: Seed-pods that grew legs where the old Aethrion irrigation still seeps. They grazed the meadow in peace until the Quickening; now a herd charges anyone who walks into it.
art_brief: A round four-legged seed with a mossy shell and two twig antennae; friendly face; earth-green palette.

habitat.note: Open grass by the camp. The Mosskin herds charge since the Quickening: learn to pull them into one heap.

name: Sporeling
ecology: Walking mushrooms that crowd the damp grove by the meadow pond. They share one spore cloud, and since the Quickening the whole cloud rushes anyone who comes near.
art_brief: A waddling mushroom with a speckled cream-and-rust cap, stubby root feet, puffs of glowing spores.

habitat.note: A damp hollow where spore clouds and resin mites rush anyone together: the first mixed pack.

name: Ambermite
ecology: Six-legged mites that farm amber resin from the trail-side trees and swarm anything that comes near the sap.
art_brief: A beetle-sized six-legged mite under a translucent amber shell with a glowing core; honey-orange.

habitat.note: A damp hollow where spore clouds and resin mites rush anyone together: the first mixed pack.

name: Lunari
ecology: Leaf-eared gliders nesting in the hollows of Dawnmeadow's Glider Rise. The Gorged ones have soaked up so much leaked aether they hardly fly; they ignore travellers but fight back hard when struck.
art_brief: A sugar-glider-like beast with leaf-shaped ears and a banded tail, membrane glide flaps; moonlit silver-green.

habitat.note: Upland grass where rock lizards hunt and a few Gorged gliders sit too heavy to fly. Gorged bounty: 30 on the map, 4x HP, 6x EXP.

name: Craglet
ecology: Rock lizards on the scree outcrops; they swallow Aethrion gears and shards as gizzard stones, which is where old copper gears turn up.
art_brief: A squat lizard covered in slate plates, quartz flecks along the spine, a gear glinting in its belly seam.

habitat.note: Upland grass where rock lizards hunt and a few Gorged gliders sit too heavy to fly.

name: Thornback
ecology: Hedgehog-boars that root in the brambles round Dawnmeadow's old mill and charge anything that walks into the thicket.
art_brief: A stocky boar with a back of woody thorns and bark-like hide; mossy tusks.

habitat.note: Brambles round an old mill: boar herds and the dust-moth horde, the field's hardest pulls.

name: Dustwing
ecology: Dust moths that ride the updraft of the old windmill's sails and dive on anything moving below.
art_brief: A large moth with sandy, powder-dusted wings and brass-coloured eyespots; trailing dust motes.

habitat.note: Brambles round an old mill: boar herds and the dust-moth horde, the field's hardest pulls.

name: Brookfin
ecology: Amphibious fish that crawl up the banks of Moonbrook Vale's Brookbed to sun their clear fins, and rush anything on two legs.
art_brief: A fat fish on stubby fin-legs, glass-clear fins showing faint aether veins; blue-green.

habitat.note: Amphibious fish crawl the shallow banks next to camp and rush anything on two legs: an easy first horde.

name: Reedstalker
ecology: Reed-camouflaged hunters of Moonbrook Vale's Reed Marsh; they spit from the reeds at anything on the banks.
art_brief: A lanky stalk-creature woven from reeds, a seed-pod head that opens to spit darts; marsh green and brown.

habitat.note: Reedstalkers spit from the reeds; Gorged Graftlings root among them, slow and rich.

name: Rotroot
ecology: Roots of the dying orchard, animated by aether leaking from the pump house; they grow thickest round its broken machine.
art_brief: A knot of rotting roots with a glowing sap core, crawling on root-legs; dark wood, sickly teal glow.

habitat.note: Rot creeps into the orchard rows from the pump-house below; newts croak their whole bank into a fight.

name: Barkwarden
ecology: Aethrion maintenance frames that grew bark over their copper joints; they still patrol Hollowroot's tunnels and buried pump hall.
art_brief: A man-high wooden guardian with copper-jointed limbs, a cracked lens eye and moss in the seams.

habitat.note: The largest Barkwarden patrol under Lumeris, in a cavern you can circle while they close in as one wall.
The buried Aethrion pump hall; the Barkwardens still guard it, and one pull empties the hall.
A quieter side cavern of Barkwardens among the roots.

name: Graftling
ecology: Fallen branches that the old Aethrion grafting frames bolted hinges onto. The Gorged ones root for days, swollen with jade sap; they ignore anyone who leaves them be and fight back when struck.
art_brief: A knee-high bundle of living twigs on three folding brass hinge-legs, a jade sap bead glowing at the joint; leaf tufts for a head; bark brown, brass, jade.

habitat.note: Reedstalkers spit from the reeds; Gorged Graftlings root among them, slow and rich. Gorged bounty: 30 on the map, 4x HP, 6x EXP.

name: Sapdrone
ecology: Aethrion harvesting drones that still tap the giant trunks of Moonbrook Vale's Sap Groves, and dive on anything that comes near the taps. A drone that drank too long sometimes carries a bead of Living Jade.
art_brief: A fist-sized brass beetle-drone with four glassy wings and a long needle proboscis, its belly tank sloshing with glowing jade sap.

habitat.note: Tapped trunks above Hollowroot: drones dive at anyone near the taps.

name: Vinecrawler
ecology: Vines that strangled a crawling Aethrion maintenance frame and now drive it; they tend the trellises of Graftwood Wilds' Trellis Dunes and attack anything that comes near a vine.
art_brief: A spider-shaped brass gear-frame wrapped and pulled by thick green vines, leaves sprouting from the gear teeth, a cracked jade lens at the core.

habitat.note: Where the grafted woods run into sand: vine constructs on the trellises, Gorged Sandcoils basking on the crests.

name: Root Sentinel
ecology: Aethrion guard frames that the elder trees' roots grew through; they walk Elderroot Expanse's Root Ridge. Their core is jade-stained, sometimes solid Living Jade.
art_brief: A three-metre humanoid guard of brass and stone, completely laced with thick roots, a lantern-like jade eye under a hood of bark.

habitat.note: Slow root-laced sentinels on the ridges, brass kites shooting from above.

name: Sandcoil
ecology: Sand serpents that bask on warm dune crests and burrow along the buried Aethrion pipes. The Gorged ones are bloated with pipe-heat and aether; they only bite when struck.
art_brief: A thick, short serpent coiled like a spring, scales the colour and grain of saffron sand, ember-orange belly, heat shimmer above it.

habitat.note: Where the grafted woods run into sand: vine constructs on the trellises, Gorged Sandcoils basking on the crests. Gorged bounty: 30 on the map, 4x HP, 6x EXP.

name: Glass Scarab
ecology: Beetles that roll lightning-glass into their shells; they swarm the fused sand of Graftwood Wilds' Glass Burrows. Old shells sometimes set into Sunfire Glass.
art_brief: A dog-sized scarab whose shell is clear amber glass with a glowing ember core showing through, legs of dark chitin.

habitat.note: Thistle hares and glass scarabs swarm the fused sand.

name: Dune Sentry
ecology: Sandstone sentries that once guarded Solenia's glass works; they walked east with the sand and now hold Elderroot Expanse's Antler Glade.
art_brief: A blocky humanoid of carved sandstone with brass bands at the joints, a slit visor glowing orange, sand pouring from its cracks.

habitat.note: Sandstone sentries under the elder trees; a few Antlered Engines hold the glade.

name: Sun Warden
ecology: Guardians of the solar ring network; they patrol the Saffron Wastes' Warden Causeway.
art_brief: A tall bronze guardian with a halo-ring of sun mirrors on its back, a faceless polished face, a long spear-gnomon.

habitat.note: Bronze wardens hold the causeway; polyps spit from the old canal.

name: Tidehopper
ecology: Spring-legged shore amphibians that feed in the tidepools. The Gorged ones sit fat in the Spore Drift, too full of sap and aether to bother anyone, until struck.
art_brief: A frog-sized blue-grey hopper with oversized hind legs, a shell-plate back and bulbous wet eyes; barnacle specks; sea-glass blue.

habitat.note: The Heartwood Engine's spores drift down to a tidal pool: bloated spore-sacs, and Gorged Tidehoppers too full to move. Gorged bounty: 30 on the map, 4x HP, 6x EXP.

name: Coral Claw
ecology: Crabs that wear living coral as armour; they patrol Saltwind's wrack line and pinch anything near their burrows. Their coral sometimes grows round a pearl.
art_brief: A crab the size of a dog, its shell overgrown with pink and orange coral branches, one claw much larger than the other; wet teal legs.

habitat.note: Brass acolytes mend the crab packs on the old coral steps; the Heartwood Engine's vents are close.

name: Brine Automaton
ecology: Copper pressure-maintenance frames that still service the pumps at the Saffron Wastes' Frost Seep; they treat every visitor as a fault to clear.
art_brief: A barrel-chested copper automaton with piston arms, brine-crusted gauges for eyes and a tank on its back hissing steam; verdigris green and brass.

habitat.note: A cold seep in the desert: pump constructs, dust revenants, and Gorged Frost Mites feeding on the thaw.

name: Relay Guardian
ecology: Sonar sentries bolted to the Drowned Relay's surface buoys; they walk the buoy cables of Pearl Coast's Relay Strand and answer anything that comes close.
art_brief: A tall diving-suit construct with a dish-shaped sonar head, ribbed hoses and lead boots; dark bronze with pulsing cyan rings.

habitat.note: Relay Guardians ping the buoy cables by the camp and answer anything that comes close.

name: Frost Mite
ecology: Crystal-shelled mites that cluster where the Aethrion heat pipes thaw the ground. The Gorged ones feed and ignore everything else, until struck.
art_brief: A palm-sized mite whose shell is a cluster of clear ice crystals, six thin blue legs, a faint glow inside; frost-white and pale cyan.

habitat.note: A cold seep in the desert: pump constructs, dust revenants, and Gorged Frost Mites feeding on the thaw. Gorged bounty: 30 on the map, 4x HP, 6x EXP.

name: Prism Wisp
ecology: Floating lights that gather where glass refracts the most sun: over the mirrors of the Saffron Wastes' Prism Reach. Their frames sometimes set into a flawless prism.
art_brief: A glowing orb inside an open lattice of hexagonal crystal, casting rainbow beams; white core, prismatic edges.

habitat.note: Borers in the old hulls, prism wisps beaming from the mirrors near the Vault.

name: Icegear
ecology: Many-legged gear walkers that maintained the coolant pumps; frozen joints made them hostile, and they stalk the frozen pumps of Pearl Coast's Pearl Beds.
art_brief: A spider-like walker with a body of stacked frozen gears and eight jointed brass legs, icicles hanging from the cogs; steel blue and brass.

habitat.note: Gorged Pearl Skates lie heavy in the pearl mud; gear walkers stalk the frozen pumps.

name: Archive Keeper
ecology: Data-keeping automatons of the Cryocore Archive's outlying vaults; they guard the flooded wing of Frostfire Divide's Drowned Archive.
art_brief: A tall slender construct in faceted crystal armour, a glowing data-slate for a face, long fingers made for handling cores; ice-blue and silver.

habitat.note: Keepers in a flooded archive wing; medusas heal them.

name: Ashcrawler
ecology: Woodlouse-like grazers that eat the warm ash blown off Emberfall's vents. Once harmless, the herds on the Ash Flats now swarm anything that crosses them.
art_brief: A dog-sized segmented crawler with a grey ash shell, ember light glowing between the plates, soot-black legs; slow and placid.

habitat.note: Ash grazers and drone swarms where ice meets the first lava, all of them hostile since the Quickening.

name: Cinder Imp
ecology: Sparks that took shape in the Aethrion vents and never cooled; they nest in hot hollows along the haul road and swarm anything that brings fresh air near the coals.
art_brief: A knee-high charcoal imp with a cracked ember belly, flame wisps for horns, long ash-grey fingers; leaves glowing footprints.

habitat.note: Cinder imps swarm round Gorged Hoarfrost Behemoths that keep on grazing.

name: Smelt Hound
ecology: Aethrion foundry hounds still loose from their kennels; packs hunt heat round Frostfire Divide's Sentry Vents.
art_brief: A lean hound of riveted iron plates over a molten core, glowing slag dripping from the jaw, bellows-ribs that pump sparks when it runs.

habitat.note: Sentries and hound packs at the vents; the Drowned Signalmind surfaces here.

name: Furnace Knight
ecology: The foundry guard of Aethrion, still marching patrols along Cinder Expanse's Knight's Road. A live furnace burns in each breastplate.
art_brief: A tall armoured automaton whose chest is an open furnace door, riveted iron plate, a long blade glowing at the edge, smoke from the helm vents.

habitat.note: Knight patrols and lurk packs on the old road.

name: Null Wisp
ecology: Knots of violet energy that bled out of the cracked conduits. The Gorged ones drift where any light is left and drink it until it goes dark; they ignore the living until struck.
art_brief: A floating smudge of violet-black light with a hollow white core, trailing wisps that dim everything they pass; no face.

habitat.note: Ranged spitters at the vents; Gorged Null Wisps drift through, drinking the light. Gorged bounty: 30 on the map, 4x HP, 6x EXP.

name: Shade Carrier
ecology: City haulers whose drivers are long gone; a shadow took the cabs and drives the old delivery loop round the park promenade and the dead pond.
art_brief: A boxy six-wheeled freight hauler with a smashed cab full of moving shadow, violet headlamps, cargo doors that open like a jaw.

habitat.note: Scraplings, haulers and blooms on the rivet heaps above the Cryocore Archive.

name: Lattice Drone
ecology: Lattice survey drones that patrol the signal gantries and the junction pit over the rail yards, firing on anything that breaks the grid.
art_brief: A floating hexagonal frame of dark metal around a violet lattice core, six thin vanes, a lens that tracks before it fires.

habitat.note: Mite crews and ranged drones in the rail yards.

name: Meridian Executor
ecology: The lattice's executioners, built to remove anything that tampers with the Meridian network. A single court of them guards the Meridian Gate.
art_brief: A gaunt four-armed automaton in black ceramic, each arm ending in a long violet blade, a mask with a single vertical slit of light.
story: The Lattice's executioners, built to remove anyone who tampers with the network. Their masks are pieces of the Keysigil that opens the Lattice Heart.

habitat.note: A few Meridian Executor elites hold the middle of Glyph Plaza.

name: Hollowroot Warden
ecology: The pump-house core, fused with the root mass it was built to water. It sits in the Heart Chamber and is why the orchard rots.
art_brief: A hulking root-and-copper colossus around a pulsing aetherite heart; pipes for arms, roots for legs.
story: Lumeris's Heart: the pump-mind that watered a whole province. After the Sundering it never stopped watering, until the roots swallowed it. The Choir turned its valves to send the deep water east, and what was left went foul. Aldric's first survey page lay in its chamber: "The pump pulls the wrong way. Someone turned the valve."

habitat.note: Where the Hollowroot Warden sits fused with the roots, pulling the water east. It wakes again minutes after it is silenced.

name: Mossback Newt
ecology: Cat-sized newts that live under the moss of the creek banks. They bask in rows and croak the whole bank into a fight the moment anyone comes close.
art_brief: A plump newt with a carpet of green moss on its back, a pale belly and round jade eyes; small water droplets glinting on the moss.

habitat.note: Rot creeps into the orchard rows from the pump-house below; newts croak their whole bank into a fight.

name: Jadewing Moth
ecology: Large moths that live in the canopy where the jade light is strongest; they drift down into Graftwood Wilds' Jadewing Glade to hunt.
art_brief: A moth the size of a hawk with translucent jade wings veined like circuitry, glowing eyespots and trailing luminous dust.

habitat.note: Moths shoot from the canopy while bark-plated hound packs rush in.

name: Barkhound
ecology: Wolf-like beasts whose hides grow bark plates; their packs den in Graftwood Wilds' Jadewing Glade and run down anything on the road.
art_brief: A lean wolf with overlapping bark plates on its back and shoulders, moss on its tail, jade-green eyes; heavy jaws with wooden fangs.

habitat.note: Moths shoot from the canopy while bark-plated hound packs rush in.

name: Pruning Tender
ecology: The Aethrion gardener machines that grafted Verdantis; they still prune and seal cuts on Graftwood Wilds' Press Terraces, and rush to any machine in trouble. Their sap tanks sometimes set into Living Jade.
art_brief: A barrel-bodied brass gardener on three spindly legs with shear-arms and a sap nozzle, a glass tank of jade sap on its back, moss on the lid.

habitat.note: Gardener machines mend each other at the old presses; jackal packs hunt the terraces.

name: Thistlehare
ecology: Hares that burrow in Graftwood Wilds' Glass Burrows; their thistle coats spread seed wherever they run, and since the Quickening they run at people.
art_brief: A long-eared hare whose fur is a mass of purple-green thistle burrs, a white cotton tail, huge dark eyes; mid-leap pose.

habitat.note: Thistle hares and glass scarabs swarm the fused sand.

name: Antlered Engine
ecology: Aethrion survey engines built in the shape of the forest's great stags; four still graze the Engine Glade beneath the Eldest and charge any intruder. Their antler coils hold Aetherite.
art_brief: A huge stag of brass ribs and living wood, antlers made of coiled copper and branches hung with moss, a furnace-glow of jade in its chest.
story: Survey engines built in the shape of the forest's great stags. Sylvarans once rode them in the spring parade. Now they charge anything that enters the glade.

habitat.note: A few Antlered Engine elites hold the middle of Antler Glade.

name: Sporebloat
ecology: Fungal sacs that grow in the Heartwood Engine's exhaust; they drift out of the vents and fill Elderroot Expanse's Spore Drift from rim to pool.
art_brief: A floating puffball the size of a barrel, dark violet with glowing jade spore-vents, short root tendrils hanging below.

habitat.note: The Heartwood Engine's spores drift down to a tidal pool: bloated spore-sacs, and Gorged Tidehoppers too full to move.

name: Spore Matron
ecology: The mother fungi that seed the Sporebloats; they stand in rings in the Engine's sap conduits and line its spore lung, and their spores drift out to the Basin.
art_brief: A tall mushroom with a wide frilled cap, a stalk like a robed figure, jade spore-lanterns hanging under the cap.

habitat.note: Spore Matrons stand in rings along the Engine's sap conduits, spitting from range. Pull them into a stack.
A smaller nest of Matrons in the Engine's spore lung, close to the root lift.

name: Heartwood Pistonguard
ecology: The guard engines of the Heartwood Engine; they hold the Piston Hall round the main piston and never leave it.
art_brief: A squat brass guardian with pistons for arms, its body cased in polished heartwood, steam and spores venting from its back.

habitat.note: Pistonguards hold the hall round the main piston: one pull brings thirty of them.

name: Heartwood Regent
ecology: The Engine's heart: an Aethrion pump fused with the oldest tree in Verdantis. It drives the sap that lights the forest and the spores that are now choking it.
art_brief: A towering figure of living wood grown round a brass pump-heart, a crown of branches, roots for legs, jade light pulsing through its veins with each pump stroke.
story: Verdantis's Heart: a sap pump fused with the oldest tree in the forest, once the source of its jade light. Tuned by the Choir, it breathes spores instead of sap to push its power further east. The Rootwardens believe it knows, and hurts. Aldric wrote: "Ilvane says trees can't feel. I'm not sure any more."

habitat.note: The Heartwood Regent's chamber, alone at the Engine's heart. It wakes again minutes after it is silenced.

name: Ochre Jackal
ecology: Pack hunters that den by the Saffron oasis and along the buried pipeline, living off caravan scraps and Sandcoil eggs.
art_brief: A rangy jackal with ochre fur, huge ears, a dark stripe down the spine and a brass tag from a long-gone caravan on its collar.

habitat.note: Gardener machines mend each other at the old presses; jackal packs hunt the terraces.

name: Brass Kite
ecology: Survey kites that still map the old routes; they circle Elderroot Expanse's Root Ridge, firing on anything that crosses their survey lines.
art_brief: A diamond-shaped kite of brass foil and cloth on a gear-driven frame, a single focusing lens in its nose, ribbon tails streaming.

habitat.note: Slow root-laced sentinels on the ridges, brass kites shooting from above.

name: Glasstail Basilisk
ecology: Lizards that lick lightning-glass and grow it along their tails; they bask in packs on Elderroot Expanse's Basilisk Flats. The tail tip sometimes hardens into Sunfire Glass.
art_brief: A low, heavy basilisk with a tail ending in a club of glowing glass, ridged sandy scales, a frilled crest that flares orange.

habitat.note: Glass-tailed basilisks bask in packs on the flats; skimmers dive from the cliffs.

name: Gnomon Acolyte
ecology: Robed brass automata that once recalibrated Solenia's sun dials; they tend the crab packs and broken machines on Elderroot Expanse's Coral Steps and rush to any that are attacked.
art_brief: A slim brass automaton in sun-bleached robes, a gnomon-shaped crest on its head, mirror-plate hands that catch the light.

habitat.note: Brass acolytes mend the crab packs on the old coral steps; the Heartwood Engine's vents are close.

name: Canal Strider
ecology: Skaters that live on the last water in the Saffron Wastes, along the Canal Shallows' channel and sluices. Since the Quickening they dart at anything on the banks.
art_brief: A water-strider the size of a pony, stilt legs tipped with silver pads, a slim teal body and silt-pearl eyes.

habitat.note: Striders dart along the last water; kelp tenders knit the packs back together.

name: Dust Revenant
ecology: The wrapped shades of Aethrion surveyors who died sealing the Vault; they walk the causeway they built and escort the lens array before the Vault door.
art_brief: A floating figure in sand-coloured burial wraps trailing dust, an empty hood lit by a dim surveyor's lamp held in a bony hand.

habitat.note: A cold seep in the desert: pump constructs, dust revenants, and Gorged Frost Mites feeding on the thaw.

name: Sand-buried Colossus
ecology: Causeway builders, buried to the chest when the dunes moved; three still dig themselves free in the Saffron Wastes' Colossus Sands. Their gear-hearts run on Aetherite.
art_brief: A giant sandstone-and-brass figure buried to the waist, one arm free and dragging, a cracked sun-disc face glowing orange.
story: Road-builders buried to the chest when the dunes moved. They still try to dig themselves free and go back to work.

habitat.note: A few Sand-buried Colossus elites hold the middle of Colossus Sands.

name: Prism Lens-drone
ecology: Focusing drones of the Heliostat Vault; they guard the Lens Foundry where Solenia's light is gathered and sent east. Their lenses can fuse sand into Sunfire Glass.
art_brief: A floating ring of brass holding a large prism, three small fins, a beam of orange light idling from its centre.

habitat.note: Lens-drones round the focusing engine that sends Solenia's light east.

name: Vault Mirrorguard
ecology: The Vault's guards, built to keep its mirrors aligned; they hold the Mirror Gallery, the Lens Foundry and the Shaft of Noon.
art_brief: A knight-shaped construct plated in polished mirror bronze, a round shield that is a heliostat mirror, a visor like a lens.

habitat.note: Mirrorguards shoulder to shoulder among the mirrors they keep aligned; a round hall to circle.
Mirrorguards in the light-shaft; drag them into the corridor where they bunch up.

name: Heliostat Sovereign
ecology: The Vault's controller: an Aethrion mind built to aim every mirror in Solenia at one point. It still focuses the desert's sun into the Heliostat Core, which is why Solenia is burning.
art_brief: A colossal throne-machine of brass rings and mirrors around a burning sun-core, arms of articulated mirror panels, a crown of lenses.
story: Solenia's Heart: the mind that aims every mirror in the desert at one point. Its last order was to gather all the light it could for the Ascension, so it has burned Solenia for three hundred years. Aldric wrote: "All the light goes east. None of it was ever meant for us."

habitat.note: The Heliostat Sovereign, alone under the great mirror. It wakes again minutes after it is silenced.

name: Gullwing Skimmer
ecology: Gulls that nest on the Saltwind cliffs and perch on the beached pump-buoy; they dive on anything that walks under the colony.
art_brief: A long-winged gull with brass-tinted primaries, a hooked orange beak and a crest of storm-grey feathers; mid-dive pose.

habitat.note: Glass-tailed basilisks bask in packs on the flats; skimmers dive from the cliffs.

name: Polyp Spitter
ecology: Walking coral colonies that root along the old canal of the Saffron Wastes' Warden Causeway, spitting barbs at anything that comes near the water.
art_brief: A squat lump of polyps on stubby root-legs, a ring of open tube mouths on top glowing magenta; pink-violet with white tips.

habitat.note: Bronze wardens hold the causeway; polyps spit from the old canal.

name: Kelp Tender
ecology: Kelp creatures that tend the weed of the Saffron Wastes' Canal Shallows; they answer any of their bed's distress, and pearl oysters grow on their fronds.
art_brief: A tall swaying figure of braided kelp with a bulb head glowing soft green, frond arms trailing; small oysters clinging to its stalk.

habitat.note: Striders dart along the last water; kelp tenders knit the packs back together.

name: Hullborer
ecology: Ship-worms grown huge on Aethrion hull-timber; they infest the old hulls of the Saffron Wastes' Prism Reach.
art_brief: A pale segmented worm with a drill-bit shell at its head, wood shavings stuck to its slime; bone-white with rust-red rasp.

habitat.note: Borers in the old hulls, prism wisps beaming from the mirrors near the Vault.

name: Pearl Skate
ecology: Skates that bury in the warm mud of the pearl beds, cracking oysters. The Gorged ones are as big as doors and too heavy to skim away; they fight back when struck.
art_brief: A wide diamond-shaped skate with a pearlescent back and a whip tail, skimming on its wing tips; sand-cream with nacre sheen.

habitat.note: Gorged Pearl Skates lie heavy in the pearl mud; gear walkers stalk the frozen pumps. Gorged bounty: 30 on the map, 4x HP, 6x EXP.

name: Thunderhull Turtle
ecology: Great turtles that bask in the warm outflow of Pearl Coast's Turtle Coils; they wear salvaged hull plating grown into their shells and defend the herd.
art_brief: A huge turtle whose shell is fused with riveted copper hull plates and a broken porthole; storm-grey skin, barnacles, glowing amber eyes.

habitat.note: Turtle herds and the serpent horde in the coil trenches.

name: Squall Ray
ecology: Manta rays that leave the sea in a gale and ride the updraft round the lightning masts of Pearl Coast's Squall Point, charging their wings on the Aethrion conductors.
art_brief: A manta ray with wing edges crackling blue, a long stinger tail with a copper tip; indigo back, white belly, floating above the ground.

habitat.note: Rays ride the gale round the lightning masts; a Glacier Juggernaut guards the way to the Heliostat Vault.

name: Pressure Drone
ecology: Maintenance drones of the Drowned Relay that followed the Signalmind's song inland; they swarm Frostfire Divide's Ash Flats.
art_brief: A football-sized brass sphere with three propeller fins and a single red lamp eye, valves venting bubbles; pitted copper and red.

habitat.note: Ash grazers and drone swarms where ice meets the first lava, all of them hostile since the Quickening.

name: Gloom Medusa
ecology: Deep-water jellyfish that bloomed in the relay's flooded gallery, feeding on the leaking aether; they float in the dark and defend the drones that keep their water warm.
art_brief: A translucent violet bell trailing long glowing tendrils, an aether-blue nucleus pulsing inside; dark halo.

habitat.note: Keepers in a flooded archive wing; medusas heal them.

name: Drowned Signalmind
ecology: The relay's control mind, which drowned with the station and kept broadcasting; it has grown a body of drone hulls and cable round its sonar array in the Sonar Chamber, and its pulses are what keep Thalassia's constructs hostile.
art_brief: A colossal brass-and-coral head on cable tentacles, a ring of sonar dishes for a crown, one great cracked lens eye glowing cyan; bubbles and sparks.
story: Thalassia's Heart: the relay that carried the Lattice's orders across Elyndra. It drowned with its station and kept broadcasting, grew a body of drone hulls and cable, and rose through the vents of Frostfire Divide. Its song is the Quickening itself. Aldric wrote: "It isn't talking to us. It's talking to the Gate."

habitat.note: Drowned Signalmind roams the open field here: a world boss for groups.

name: Rimehare
ecology: Hares of the open snowfields that burrow in drifts. Once they bolted from people; now they burst out of the snow and bite.
art_brief: A big white hare with frost-tipped ears and long whiskers rimed with ice, hind legs built for bounding; snow-white, silver-blue shadows.

habitat.note: Rimehares burst from the drifts round three half-buried colossi.

name: Glassback Ram
ecology: Mountain rams that graze lichen on Pearl Coast's Ram Terraces; their horns grow volcanic glass, and old rams carry prisms in their horn cores.
art_brief: A shaggy grey ram with curled horns of translucent blue glass and a back of glassy plates; breath steaming.

habitat.note: Glass-backed ram flocks on the terraces.

name: Frostcoil Serpent
ecology: Serpents that drank leaking coolant and grew cold-blooded beyond nature; they nest in the coil trenches of Pearl Coast's Turtle Coils.
art_brief: A long pale-blue serpent with frost-ridged scales and a hood of thin ice fins, glowing coolant-cyan veins along its belly.

habitat.note: Turtle herds and the serpent horde in the coil trenches.

name: Glacier Juggernaut
ecology: Aethrion plough mechs that still clear the road on their old schedule, crushing anything on it; they hold Pearl Coast's Squall Point, by the way to the Heliostat Vault.
art_brief: A tracked mech twice a man's height with a huge wedge plough blade, a furnace glowing in its chest and frost-crusted armour; rust-red and steel.
story: Snow ploughs that still run their old timetable over the coast road, crushing whatever stands on it.

habitat.note: A few Glacier Juggernaut elites hold the middle of Squall Point.

name: Mirrorshade
ecology: Reflections that stepped out of polished ice where the lens array focused aether; they drift over Frostfire Divide's Slag Mirrors and defend whatever stands near them.
art_brief: A humanoid silhouette of dark mirror glass, reflecting its surroundings warped, edges smoking into shadow; one bright eye-glint.

habitat.note: Toads in the slag pools under mirror ice; mirrorshades mend them.

name: Hoarfrost Behemoth
ecology: Woolly grazers that dig lichen from the ice shores. Gorged on aether from the vents, they keep grazing while you walk past, and hit back like avalanches when struck.
art_brief: A mammoth-sized beast with a hump of frost-matted wool, four curling tusks and icicles in its fur; white and slate grey.

habitat.note: Cinder imps swarm round Gorged Hoarfrost Behemoths that keep on grazing. Gorged bounty: 30 on the map, 4x HP, 6x EXP.

name: Cryo Sentry
ecology: Security frames of the ring conduit that powers the Archive; they patrol Frostfire Divide's Sentry Vents and chase whatever leaks from them.
art_brief: A tripod construct with a long frost lance for a head, a cryo cell glowing in its chest, frost venting from its joints; white enamel and cyan.

habitat.note: Sentries and hound packs at the vents; the Drowned Signalmind surfaces here.

name: Archive Specter
ecology: Fragments of recorded minds that leaked out of the Cryocore Archive's cracked data-cores; they drift between its data stacks and index shelves.
art_brief: A flickering translucent figure made of scrolling glyph-light, trailing like smoke, face a blank of static; violet and cold white.

habitat.note: Archive Specters drift between the data-stack rows; the rows make lanes for line skills.
Specters among the index shelves on the way to the vault, taken shelf by shelf.

name: Cryo Lancer
ecology: Guardian frames of the Archive; they hold the cryo wards, the cold stacks and the index gallery against anything that moves.
art_brief: A slim armoured construct with a long rifle-like lance arm, a prism focus at its tip, frosted visor; white and pale blue.

habitat.note: Cryo Lancers shoot across a round ward; pillars and crystal give cover, so close in.

name: Cryocore Curator
ecology: The Archive's curator intelligence, wound round the cryocore in the Curator's Vault; it freezes anything that might disturb its records, which is why Crystallis's machines turned hostile.
art_brief: A towering construct of crystal shelving and brass arms around a glowing blue cryocore, data-slates orbiting it like moons, a frost crown.
story: Crystallis's Heart: keeper of Aethrion's memory, including Archon Ysra Callow's warnings against the Ascension. It freezes anyone who comes near, believing it still protects her words. Silenced, it lets them be read: the Gate needs the power of the six Hearts, and whoever stands in it becomes its voice.

habitat.note: The Cryocore Curator guards Archon Ysra Callow's warnings here. It wakes again minutes after it is silenced.

name: Slagback Toad
ecology: Toads that soak in cooling slag; the slag sets on their backs as armour. They crowd the pools of Frostfire Divide's Slag Mirrors.
art_brief: A boulder-sized toad with a cracked black slag shell on its back, orange heat in the cracks, wide throat sac glowing like a bellows.

habitat.note: Toads in the slag pools under mirror ice; mirrorshades mend them.

name: Crucible Tender
ecology: Repair automata that once tended the forges; they still patch every hound they find, and pick over the slag heaps for scrap to do it with.
art_brief: A four-legged brass spider-frame with a welding arc on one arm and a slag scoop on the other; blue-white arc light, soot-stained lens.

habitat.note: Repair automata scavenge the yards by the camp and weld anything they find.

name: Vent Skink
ecology: Lizards that bask on vent rims and dive into the lava to cool off; colonies ring the Vents' magma pool and spill into the ash wash and round the heat-tap drill.
art_brief: A slim lizard with glossy black basalt scales, a glowing orange throat and tail tip, heat shimmer over its back.

habitat.note: Skinks along the lava channels.

name: Magma Spitter
ecology: Armoured worms that root in lava fissures and spit what they swallow; they line the Vents' southern fissure and the heat-tap ridge.
art_brief: A thick segmented worm half out of a fissure, a crusted shell collar and a tube mouth dripping magma; dull red with yellow-hot gullet.

habitat.note: Ranged spitters at the vents; Gorged Null Wisps drift through, drinking the light.

name: Rivet Scrapling
ecology: Scrap-built drones that strip the collapsed bridges for rivets and hoard them in heaps on Cinder Expanse's Rivet Moraine.
art_brief: A fist-sized rattling bundle of rivets, bolts and a single glowing gear-eye on wire legs; moves in jittering hops.

habitat.note: Scraplings, haulers and blooms on the rivet heaps above the Cryocore Archive.

name: Slagforged Brute
ecology: Slag that set in the crucible moulds and walked off; brutes stand in the Veil Rift's Brute Pens where they were first cast.
art_brief: A hulking ogre-shape of rough black slag with mould seams down its sides, a molten core showing through cracks, iron bands still on its fists.

habitat.note: Slag-forged brutes in the pens by the camp.

name: Pour Wraith
ecology: Molten metal that kept its shape after the last pour; wraiths drift along the Veil Rift's Wraith Pour, beside the tear.
art_brief: A dripping humanoid of white-hot liquid metal with no face, trailing a cooling grey skin that cracks and re-melts; a mould seam down its middle.

habitat.note: Wraiths and the riftling horde along the tear in the Veil.

name: Zero Stoker
ecology: The stokers of Furnace Zero, the first Aethrion furnace, still shovelling into a fire that no longer needs feeding. They followed Kiln Prime up onto the Veil Rift's Stoker Heights.
art_brief: A broad-shouldered iron automaton with a shovel for one arm and a coal hopper on its back, firebox glow behind a grille face.

habitat.note: Stokers still feed the fire; Gorged Sparkwings sit charged on the dishes. Kiln Prime walks the heights.

name: Kiln Prime
ecology: The governing intelligence of Furnace Zero, the first furnace of Aethrion. It runs the whole of Emberfall's foundry as one body, and now walks the Veil Rift's Stoker Heights itself.
art_brief: A colossal kiln-shaped automaton rising from the core floor, crucible arms that pour molten metal, a white-hot Aetherite heart behind a lattice grille.
story: Emberfall's Heart: the mind of Furnace Zero, the first furnace of Aethrion, which runs every hound, knight and stoker in the province as one body. The Choir set it to forge the Keysigil that opens the Lattice Heart, then it climbed to the Stoker Heights on its own. Aldric wrote: "The key is forged. She is two days ahead of me."

habitat.note: Kiln Prime roams the open field here: a world boss for groups.

name: Gutter Lurk
ecology: Pale, long-limbed scavengers that live under the fallen overpasses and in the drowned gutters of the outskirts, picking over what the wisps leave behind.
art_brief: A hairless grey cat-sized scavenger with long fingers, huge reflective eyes and a ridge of violet-lit bristles along the spine.

habitat.note: Knight patrols and lurk packs on the old road.

name: Nullbloom
ecology: Flowers that grew under Aethrion grow-lamps after the lamps turned to null light; they drink colour itself and spread through the park beds and black glasshouses.
art_brief: A waist-high flower with petals of matte black glass, a violet light-drinking eye at the centre, roots that leave grey patches where they walk.

habitat.note: Scraplings, haulers and blooms on the rivet heaps above the Cryocore Archive.

name: Coupler Mite
ecology: Track-maintenance mites that still couple and uncouple dead carriages in the rail yards; crews strip loose rail off the stalled line and the junction pit.
art_brief: A beetle-sized steel mite shaped like a rail coupler, pincer jaws, a single violet status light blinking on its back.

habitat.note: Mite crews and ranged drones in the rail yards.

name: Riftling
ecology: Shadow that spilled from the tear in the Veil and took the shapes of the city's lost pets; they swarm the rift's edges and have overrun the whole district, from the tilted blocks to the leaning spires.
art_brief: A dog-shaped hole in the world: a black silhouette with violet edges and white pinpoint eyes, flickering at the outline.

habitat.note: Wraiths and the riftling horde along the tear in the Veil.

name: Sparkwing
ecology: Birds that roost on the receiver dishes and feed on the static arcing between the masts. The Gorged ones are too charged to lift off and fight back only when struck.
art_brief: A crow-sized bird with feathers like copper foil, sparks crackling between the wingtips, violet arcs jumping when it lands.

habitat.note: Stokers still feed the fire; Gorged Sparkwings sit charged on the dishes. Kiln Prime walks the heights. Gorged bounty: 30 on the map, 4x HP, 6x EXP.

name: Array Sentinel
ecology: Umbracrest's guard automatons. The Gorged ones stand idle in rings round the colonnade, drowsy with stored aether; they wake and fight only when struck.
art_brief: A tall, faceless sentinel in layered dark plate, a halberd of lattice light, a violet ring rotating behind its head.

habitat.note: Glyph swarms drift between the columns round Gorged sentinels, half asleep on their posts. Gorged bounty: 30 on the map, 4x HP, 6x EXP.

name: Glyph Swarm
ecology: Floating glyphs of the Meridian Lattice's own language, policing the plazas where its lines converge; they thicken round the Gate, where the lines meet above the Heart.
art_brief: A cloud of glowing violet glyphs that hangs together in the shape of a sigil, spinning when it attacks.

habitat.note: Glyph swarms drift between the columns round Gorged sentinels, half asleep on their posts.
The glyph swarm horde; a court of Executors stands at the plaza's heart.
Glyphs thicken by the sealed descent to the Lattice Heart.

name: Lattice Weaver
ecology: Spider-frames that repair the Meridian Lattice itself; they work the loom chamber inside the Heart and string new lines through its conduits and halls.
art_brief: A long-legged spider of dark brass with a violet spinneret, drawing lines of light between its legs as it moves.

habitat.note: Lattice Weavers string new lines round a crystal; circle it to break their line of fire.
Weavers at work on the short route to the Sovereign; pull them back into the corridor.
Weavers in the long machine hall on the far route; the best Lattice Node farm.

name: Lattice Sovereign
ecology: The Meridian Lattice's own mind, woken by the Sundering. From the Heart it runs every drone, sentinel and glyph in Nocthaven; the violet grid across the city is its nervous system.
art_brief: A vast crowned lattice of violet light suspended over the chamber floor, a dark crystalline core inside, sentinel-like arms unfolding from the grid.
story: The mind of the whole Meridian Lattice, still carrying out High Archon Maelis Orlenne's last order: open the Gate until the light is enough. The six Hearts feed it, so it can only be reached once they sleep, and only with the Keysigil. Inside, it speaks with Ilvane Thorne's voice, and Aldric Venn's ward still holds the Gate half shut. Silenced, it closes the Gate partway and the Rift stops growing. It always wakes again. Hence the Long Watch.

habitat.note: The Lattice Sovereign, speaking with Ilvane Thorne's voice, and Aldric Venn's failing ward. The Long Watch keeps it silenced.
